target_customer: Regulated institutions: professional services, financial services and government agencies
problem: Organizations are overwhelmed by data and generic AI tools lack auditability. Capitol runs inside enterprise infrastructure and turns proprietary data into auditable reports and decision artifacts.
business_model: Enterprise software platform, single tenant hosting; pricing not public
product_category: Governed AI workflow and report generation platform

founders.name: Shaun Modi
founders.background_notes: Designer by background per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating models over private data with lineage, approvals and single tenant deployment is solid enterprise engineering rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded workflows, governance and security certifications create stickiness, but model access is commoditized.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source on copying; incumbent names are a judgment.

market_need_then: Regulated institutions needed auditable AI; the 2022 funding press framed the early product as decision making data stories for health insurers.

identity.visual_style: Design led, tagline Clarity on Command

rebrands.why: Not stated; 2022 press uses Capitol, YC and site use Capitol AI

brand_strength.rationale: The founder is a designer and the name suits institutions, but no press about the brand was found and the name overlaps with other Capitol brands.

pivots.from: AI data stories platform for health insurers and business teams
pivots.to: Sovereign AI operating system for regulated institutions
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from 2022 press versus current site, date unverified

outcome_analysis: Capitol raised a 10M seed in 2022 with a notable angel list, joined YC Summer 2024 at about 11 people, and reports a Series A in 2025. It repositioned toward regulated, auditable enterprise AI and says it will raise again once ARR and profitability targets are met. No distress reports found.
notes: Seed was before the YC batch. Series A amount not found: Caplight lists 17.5M total raised but this is unverified; Series A source is the company's own about page seen via search snippet (led by Together Fund per the company) and CEO interview via Mergermarket says funding completed in early 2025. Round stage on Standout differs (seed). No competitor source dated near founding found, so the list is empty. Pivot date is an inference. The founding year 2021 is from the YC page.
